releasePolicy: Public layout-first release: 6 existing original masters remain available; 24 additional lessons are explicitly locked as planned until source and text review, with no draft content or audio distributed.
sourcePolicy: Qurʾān, authentic Sunnah, verified Athār; no unattributed sayings or invented unseen narratives.
masterAudioPolicy: One canonical master text per lesson; audio is published only after exact-text QA.
